#
# The check is blocking: the CI job fails for every reachable vulnerability that
# is not listed here. Add a line only with a link to the advisory, the reason
# there is no fix, and a date to revisit. Remove it as soon as a fixed release
# is available.
#

# vulnerability database (checked 2026-10-27).
#
# govulncheck also reports GO-2026-5617, GO-2026-5668 and GO-2026-5746 at module
# level for the same dependency. They are not reachable from Orvyn, so they do
